career_path_block.说明: Vulnerable to replacement by AI and integrated equipment

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but uncertainty from project-based work. AI simplifies operations, but irregular bookings and nonstop peak seasons are more immediate challenges.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but project-based work. Jobs follow projects, creating nonstop peak seasons and quiet periods without bookings. Equipment changes quickly, so technicians must keep learning. Late-night cabling and heavy lifting also impose substantial physical demands.
risks: Income volatility: project work with clear peak and off seasons
Health effects of late nights: overnight setup and teardown are routine
Rapid equipment change: falling behind without learning new technology
Live pressure: direct accountability for streaming failures
Physical strain: moving equipment, routing cables, and standing by on site

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can automate mixing, noise reduction, and camera switching. When a live stream drops and viewers flood the comments, the technician with a tool kit and a recovery plan still has to solve the problem.

responsibilities: Set up and test audio and video equipment
Operate mixing, switching, and live-stream systems
Maintain stable live sound, images, and streaming
Maintain equipment and resolve unexpected failures

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 和一体化设备替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「项目制的不确定性」——AI 会简化操作，但接不到活、旺季连轴转，才是这行更现实的挑战。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「项目型工作」——活跟着项目走，旺季连轴转、淡季没单接，设备更新快、要不断学新东西；熬夜布线、搬设备对身体的消耗也不小。
risks: 收入波动：项目制，淡旺季明显
熬夜伤身：深夜布场收场是常态
设备更新快：不学新技术就掉队
现场压力：直播事故责任直接
体力损耗：搬设备、走线、蹲守

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动混音、降噪、切画面，但直播断流那一刻观众在评论区刷屏，站上救场的还得是那个手里有工具包、脑子里有预案的技术员。

responsibilities: 操作调音导播与直播系统
保障现场音画与直播稳定
维护设备并处理突发故障

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but radiation and high pressure + narrow skills. Technologists who do not develop interpretation and procedural-support ability will lose tracing-only work to AI.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but radiation and high pressure + heavy responsibility. Catheterization labs involve radiation, a fast pace, and no room for error. AI-assisted imaging also takes over some measurement and initial screening, so technologists need to advance toward procedural support and interpretation.
risks: Radiation exposure in catheterization labs
Fast pace and heavy responsibility
AI takes over routine tracing
Long periods standing during procedures
Certification and training costs

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well AI labels waveforms, technologists still determine whether electrodes are placed correctly and whether procedural support is steady. Their eyes monitor, their hands assist, and their voices report. People remain essential in the catheterization lab.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「辐射与高压 + 技能单一」——不补判读与跟台，只描图会被 AI 吃。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「辐射与高压 + 责任重」——导管室有射线、节奏快、出不得错；同时 AI 影像辅助在吃部分测量与初筛，技术员要向「术中配合与判读」升级。
risks: 导管室有射线
节奏快责任重
AI 吃常规描图
需长期站立跟台
证书与培训成本

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管 AI 多会标波形，那电极贴得准不准、术中配合稳不稳，最后还是技术员的眼去看、手去扶、嘴去报——导管室这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.路径: Finish carpenter or custom furniture maker

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but physical strain combined with narrow skills. Workers who only carry materials through brute force are pushed out as they age. Move into finish carpentry, project management, or an independent studio, and experience makes your craft more valuable over time.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks come not from AI but from physical strain and the worksite. Dust and noise damage health, power saws and blades can cause injury, work at height creates fall risk, and years of work can harm the back and hearing.
risks: Health damage from dust and noise: wood dust and hearing loss accumulate over time
Risk of injury from power saws, blades, and machinery
Falls from work at height and strain from material handling
Income volatility: workloads rise and fall with the market
Declining stamina with age creates pressure to transition

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate the cutting plan that wastes the least material, but an experienced carpenter still needs trained hands and eyes to lever a column that is half a millimeter out of line back into position and to avoid loading a knot in a board. Machines cannot replace this craft, and it is why the occupation endures.

responsibilities: Lay out, measure, and cut materials according to plans
Cut and assemble structural wood components
Install woodwork such as doors, windows, flooring, and ceilings
Inspect and adjust work while coordinating on-site operations

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「身体与技能单一」——只会蛮力搬料的人会随年龄被淘汰；往精细木作、项目管理或自主工作室走，手艺越老越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「身体与现场」——粉尘噪音伤身、电锯刀具伤人、高处作业有坠落风险，多年下来腰背和听力都是硬伤。
risks: 粉尘噪音伤身：木尘与听力是长期账
电锯刀具与机械伤害风险
高处作业与搬运劳损
收入波动：活多活少看行情
年龄增长后体力下滑，转型压力

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出最省料的切割方案，但现场那根歪了半毫米的柱子要怎么借力校直、那块带结的板子该怎么避开受力点，还得靠老师傅的手和眼——这是机器代替不了的手艺，也是这个职业存在的理由。

responsibilities: 按图纸放线测量并下料
安装门窗地板吊顶等木作
检验修整并配合现场作业

career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest career risks are shrinking counter operations and accountability for errors. Roles are declining while tolerance for mistakes is falling.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main career risks are shrinking counter operations and processing errors. Government self-service terminals and online services divert standardized cases, while document review allows little room for error. Missing one requirement can force a rejection and create accountability.
risks: Online services and self-service terminals reduce routine counter roles
Processing errors carry serious accountability; missed documents create liability
Continuous monitoring makes work highly transparent
Systems compress standardized intake
Performance is tied to counter-service metrics, creating pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, people still issue licenses, review documents, and calm citizens under pressure. Human work remains necessary at the counter. This is career exploration guidance, not a guarantee of employment or a hiring decision.

career_path_block.说明: 独立受理 + 审核责任

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「窗口收缩 + 差错追责」——岗位在变少，容错在变低。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「窗口收缩 + 操作差错」——政务自助终端和网办把标准化业务分流，同时材料审核容错低，一项漏核就要退件担责。
risks: 网办与自助终端分流，纯窗口岗位在减少
操作差错追责重，材料漏核要担责
全程监控，工作高度透明
标准化受理被系统压缩
绩效与窗口指标挂钩，压力大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，证照还是人发的、材料还是人核的、群众急了还是人安抚的——窗口这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but standardization. Tools replace slide reading, while faculty who teach practice and supervise research become more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but standardization. Tools accelerate the creation of course materials and question banks, while case analysis, internship supervision, and ethical guidance still require people. Academic promotion also brings substantial pressure.
risks: Course-material generation replaces tasks
Course preparation becomes faster
Research and promotion pressure
Competition for permanent positions
Slide-only teaching faces replacement

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable tools become, teachers still decide which cases to teach, how to analyze them, and how to guide students. Human judgment, instruction, and ethical leadership remain central to education. This is career-exploration guidance, not a forecast, hiring decision, or employment guarantee.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「标准化」——念 PPT 被工具替，会讲实务、能带研究的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不在 AI，而在「标准化」——课件与题库生成工具把备课提速，但案例拆解、带实习与价值引导仍要人；同时学术岗晋升压力大。
risks: 课件生成替代
备课被提速
科研晋升压
编制竞争
纯念书被替

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪个案子该讲、怎么拆、学生怎么带，最后还是教师去想、去讲、去立——育人这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Physical work vulnerable to machinery replacement

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but production accidents and personnel risk. The supervisor carries primary safety responsibility and cannot set it aside.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI, but natural uncertainty and front-line conflict. Weather and market swings alter production plans, while worker management, safety responsibility, and output pressure concentrate on the supervisor.
risks: Dependence on nature: weather and market swings directly affect production
Heavy front-line safety responsibility: supervisors answer first for accidents
Pressure from both sides: management pushes while workers resist
Seasonal employment creates high turnover and difficult management
Remote locations can have demanding living and working conditions

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can schedule production, calculate output, and inspect fields, but a supervisor still needs to call out the final cleanup before the crew finishes.

responsibilities: Set work plans and assign tasks
Implement safety and environmental requirements and coordinate resources

career_path_block.说明: 经营与统筹能力要求高

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「生产事故与用人风险」——主管是安全第一责任人，这顶帽子戴上了就摘不掉。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「靠天吃饭 + 一线矛盾」——天气和行情波动直接影响生产计划，工人管理、安全责任、收成压力都集中在主管一个人身上。
risks: 靠天吃饭，天气与行情波动直接影响生产
一线安全责任重，出事故第一个担责
两头受气：上压下、下抵触
季节性用工，人员流动大管理难
偏远地区工作生活条件艰苦

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能排农事、算产量、巡地块，但工头那一声「收工前把地边清干净」，还是得主管扯着嗓子喊。

responsibilities: 制定作业计划并分配任务
落实安全环保与资源协调

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Food Servers, Nonrestaurant lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this role is not AI but medium-risk exposure combined with scope of responsibility. Judgment and final review for Food Servers, Nonrestaurant still rest with people; AI only handles structurable tasks.
risks: Responsibility and compliance-boundary pressure in Food Servers, Nonrestaurant work.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

hot_skills: Professional certification for Food Servers, Nonrestaurant
responsibilities: Develop and execute work plans related to Food Servers, Nonrestaurant.
Take responsibility for the quality and risk of Food Servers, Nonrestaurant outputs.
Coordinate resources and deliver Food Servers, Nonrestaurant projects.
Review and improve Food Servers, Nonrestaurant processes and methods.

skills.技能: Professional methods for Food Servers, Nonrestaurant

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——非餐厅食品服务员的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——非餐厅食品服务员的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Food Servers, Nonrestaurant领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Food Servers, Nonrestaurant相关的工作方案。
对Food Servers, Nonrestaurant产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Food Servers, Nonrestaurant项目交付。
复盘优化Food Servers, Nonrestaurant流程与方法。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not complete AI replacement. Smart video and behavior analytics speed up routine monitoring, putting screen-only workers under the most pressure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI itself. Smart video and behavior analytics accelerate routine screen monitoring, reducing screen-only roles. Professionals who assess cases, write compliance reports, and coordinate with regulators remain more resilient.
risks: Smart video accelerates screen monitoring
Behavior analytics replaces some observation
Automated compliance reporting
Physical strain from night shifts
Pressure from internal investigations

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, people still decide which activity is suspicious, how deeply to investigate, and how to coordinate with regulators. Compliance cannot remove human judgment, investigation, and report writing completely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 整体取代，而是「智能视频 + 行为分析」把常规盯屏提速，只会看屏的人会被挤。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「智能视频 + 行为分析」把常规盯屏提速，纯看监控的人被挤压；能研判案件、能写合规报告、能对接监管的人更稳。
risks: 智能视频提速盯屏
行为分析替代观察
合规自动化报送
夜班身体损耗
内部压力风险

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪笔可疑、怎么深挖、监管怎么对接，最后还是监控与调查的人去想、去查、去写——合规这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but intelligent fixtures plus presets: systems absorb basic lighting, while on-site professionals with aesthetic judgment become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but automated lighting control plus intelligent fixtures. Preset scenes and automated followspots absorb routine lighting, while complex live environments still need human coordination.
risks: Intelligent lighting absorbs routine roles
Preset-scene replacement
Automated followspot replacement
High project volatility
Live-incident risk

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, lighting technicians still use their eyes, hands, and judgment to decide which light suits each scene, how to make live changes with the director, and how to stabilize unexpected events. People cannot be fully removed from lighting.

responsibilities: Follow the action with the director

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「智能灯 + 预设」——基础打光被系统吃，有审美现场手反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化控灯 + 智能灯具」——预设场景和自动追光吃掉常规打光，但复杂现场的临场调度仍要人。
risks: 智能灯吃常规岗
预设场景替代
自动化追光替代
项目波动大
现场事故风险

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪场该用什么光、怎么跟导演临场改、突发怎么平，最后还是灯光师的眼去看、手去推、脑去定——光这一头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is automation and process control absorbing standard monitoring. Workers with strong judgment remain more stable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is automation and process control. Sensors and systems absorb standard temperature adjustment, while high-temperature fault judgment and tapping rhythm still require people on site.
risks: Process control absorbs standard roles
High-temperature safety risks
Growing environmental pressure
Fatigue from continuous operations
Unexpected equipment failures

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, operators still decide which heat is ready, how to handle splashing, and where safety limits lie. Human eyes monitor, hands operate, and minds decide at the furnace.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 过程控制」——标准监控被系统吃，有判断力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 过程控制」——传感器和控制系统吃掉标准调温，但高温故障判断与出钢节奏仍要人守在现场。
risks: 过程控制吃标准岗
高温安全风险
环保压力增大
连续作业疲劳
设备突发故障

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪一炉该出、怎么处置喷溅、安全红线在哪，最后还是操作工的眼去盯、手去扳、脑去断——炉子这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are scarce positions + a long training cycle. AI cannot take away your craft, but entry is already narrow and few people persist to the end.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risks are scarce positions and intense responsibility. Conservators require extremely long training, established posts are limited, and competition is fierce. Treatments are irreversible, so one mistake can cause an unrecoverable loss, creating constant psychological pressure.
risks: Scarce positions: limited established posts and overall openings
Long training cycle: many years from entry to independent practice
Irreversible risk: conservation errors cannot be undone
Limited income: a salary ceiling at public institutions
Market volatility: heritage investment depends on policy

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can reconstruct a digital twin of an artifact, but machines cannot replace the judgment that identifies the source of deterioration in a bronze and determines how to treat it without causing harm, a responsibility owed to history.

responsibilities: Assess artifact condition and develop plans
Perform cleaning, infill, and other treatments
Protect objects during exhibitions and loans
skills: Material and deterioration testing and analysis

career_risk_cards.callout: 修复师最大的风险不是 AI，而是「岗位稀缺 + 培养周期长」——AI 抢不走你的手艺，但入行的门本就窄，能坚持到底的人更少。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「岗位稀缺与责任压力」：修复师培养周期极长、编制岗位有限，竞争激烈；修复操作不可逆，一旦失误就是不可挽回的损失，心理压力常年在线。

培养周期长：入行到独立需多年
不可逆风险：修复失误无法挽回
收入有限：事业单位薪资天花板
市场波动：文博投入受政策影响

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能重建文物的数字分身，但「这块青铜的病根在哪、怎么修才不伤它」——这份要对历史负责的判断，机器替不了。

responsibilities: 评估文物状态并制定方案
执行清洗补配等修复操作
skills: 环境监测与预防性保护

High income flexibility, with business pressure

career_risk_cards.callout: Psychology's greatest risk is not AI, but a long investment cycle + burnout. AI can score assessments and write records, but it cannot preserve the therapeutic relationship, which requires long-term training and self-care.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but licensure barriers and burnout. Independent practice requires systematic training and accumulated supervision over a long period. Continual exposure to negative emotions and intensive empathy creates substantial burnout, while early-career income is generally low.
risks: Licensure barrier: long training and supervision cycle
Burnout: sustained high empathy creates exhaustion
Income disparity: relatively low early-career income
Responsibility pressure: crisis cases and ethical risks
Disordered market: inconsistent industry qualification systems

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can memorize every psychological theory and produce polished analytical reports, but only human warmth can gradually build the trust that lets someone speak what is in their heart.

responsibilities: Conduct psychological assessments and analyze standardized measures
Design research and participate in training

career_path_block.说明: 轻症支持可能被 AI 分流
career_path_block.路径: AI 情绪陪伴/轻量工具

career_path_block.说明: 收入弹性大，经营压力也有

career_risk_cards.callout: 心理学最大的风险不是 AI，而是「投入周期长 + 职业耗竭」——AI 能替你算量表、写记录，替不了你守住咨询关系，而关系恰恰需要长期训练与自我照料。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「执照门槛与职业耗竭」：独立执业需要系统训练与督导积累，过程漫长；长期面对负面情绪与高共情投入，职业倦怠率不低，新手期收入也普遍不高。
risks: 执照门槛：受训与督导周期长
职业耗竭：长期高共情易倦怠
收入分化：新手期收入偏低
责任压力：危机个案与伦理风险
市场混乱：行业资质体系不统一

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能背下所有心理学理论、做出漂亮的分析报告，但「让一个人愿意把心里的话说出来」——这份信任，只能用人的温度慢慢建立。

responsibilities: 实施心理评估与量表分析

career_path_block.路径: Pure reader and tag testing role

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but remaining in pure testing. Test engineers who cannot design solutions or understand applications are easier to automate and cannot reach the income ceiling.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this role is not AI but a narrow, project-based industry. RFID is a specialized IoT field with roles concentrated in certain industries and cities. Launches bring deadline pressure, while slow-season order shortages create clear income volatility.
risks: Industry specialization: roles concentrate in certain industries and cities
Project volatility: launch deadlines and slow order seasons
Frequent travel: field implementation and troubleshooting dominate
Technology evolution: rising ultra-high-frequency and software requirements
Income ceiling: pure testing roles have limited upside

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate read-rate data clearly, but an RFID specialist working in the warehouse still decides where to move antennas and which tag type to use.

responsibilities: Deploy and integrate systems on site

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在纯测试层」——不会方案设计、不懂场景的测试工程师，既容易被自动化替代，也够不到收入天花板。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业窄、项目制」——RFID 是物联网里的细分领域，岗位集中在特定行业和城市；项目上线有节点压力，淡季订单不足时收入波动明显。
risks: 行业细分：岗位集中在特定行业与城市
项目制波动：上线节点压力与订单淡季
出差频繁：现场实施与排障占大头
技术迭代：超高频与软件化要求上升
收入天花板：纯测试岗上限有限

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能帮你把读取率数据算得清清楚楚，但天线往哪挪、标签换哪一种——这些答案，还得靠蹲在仓库里的 RFID 专家。

responsibilities: 选型并配置 RFID 设备

career_path_block.说明: Replaced by scanning and computer vision

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not sudden AI replacement but gradual erosion. Systems consume repetitive verification roles piece by piece, and by the time workers react it can be too late. Proactively learn WMS and inventory analysis and move toward management.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are repetitive work and replaceability, not AI itself. Standardized count verification is being replaced by scanning, visual weighing, and automatic system reconciliation. Workers who do not learn new skills are easily removed.
risks: Automation replacement: visual weighing and scan-based counting reduce jobs
Repetitive work: verification and entry are tedious and mentally draining
Overtime pressure: peak seasons bring high volumes and rapid pace
Heavy responsibility: one incorrect entry affects the entire chain
Narrow advancement: system skills are necessary to move up

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can reconcile automatically, weigh visually, and count by scanning, but when a driver says the truck carries 500 boxes and the system says 495, someone still has to resolve the discrepancy on site. That is why the role will not disappear overnight, but it will become less common. You must be worth the cost of finding the answer.

responsibilities: Take samples for testing and register them

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 突然取代，而是「温水煮青蛙」——重复核对岗被系统一点点吃掉，等反应过来已经晚了。主动学 WMS、库存分析，往管理岗走，才是破局。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「重复劳动与替代性」——核对点数这类标准化工作正被扫码、视觉称重和系统自动对账替代，不学新技能很容易被优化。
risks: 自动化替代：视觉称重与扫码清点挤压岗位
重复劳动：核对录入枯燥伤神
加班压力：旺季货量大节奏快
责任重：错一笔账影响整链
晋升通道窄：不学系统难往上走

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动对账、视觉称重、扫码清点，但司机说「我这车货明明是 500 箱」而系统是 495 箱时，谁来现场把这件事弄明白？还是你——所以这岗位不会一夜消失，但会越来越少，你得让自己值那个「弄明白」的钱。
